text:
Sofia L.: Heads-up: NimbleWorks flipped owners on three accounts via the cloud marketplace 'co_sell_confirm' toggle. Two have joint announcement windows next week. Need a quick guardrail so we don't end up with conflicting outreach.

Ethan J.: Which accounts? demos or press at risk?

Sofia L.: acct_8201 (press/launch planned 5/2), acct_8210 (POC), acct_8222 (early). They set co_sell_confirm=true in the marketplace payload and SF ownership changed instantly.

Priya S.: Yikes. Marketplace shouldn't auto-change owner without partnerships ack. Proposed: any external 'co_sell_confirm' must create a pending_review tag and a 48h hold for announcements.

Kunal (NimbleWorks): Sorry about the surprise. NimbleWorks followed the onboarding checklist and assumed the marketplace flag meant mutual agreement. We can pause outreach and revert if needed.

Ethan J.: Immediate asks: 1) revert ownership on acct_8201 till announcement plan is synchronized; 2) add co_sell_role enum (SI_lead/Redwood_lead/Joint); 3) add announcement_hold for marketplace-driven co-sell claims.

Priya S.: I'll stage a CRM rule. Draft YAML: 
```yaml
trigger: marketplace_co_sell_confirm
actions:
  - tag: "pending-co-sell-review"
  - notify: ["partnerships", "owner"]
  - create_task: "confirm_co_sell"
  - hold_announcements: 48h
  - revert_owner_if_unconfirmed: 48h
```

Sofia L.: Good. Also: require a marketplace checkbox: "customer_acknowledged_joint_play" and a free-text 'announce_window' field. That way we can coordinate PR/marketing windows.

Kunal (NimbleWorks): We'll add the checkbox to our intake flow and set announce_window for acct_8201 to 2026-05-02. NimbleWorks will not do any public outreach until partnerships confirms.

crm-bot: Automated note added to acct_8201, acct_8210, acct_8222: "Marketplace co-sell claim detected. Pending partnerships review (48h hold on announcements)." :white_check_mark:

Ethan J.: I'll take the acct_8201 announcement coordination with Marketing and NimbleWorks. Priya, after you stage the rule, can you add an automated link in the task to a short checklist: confirm customer approval, confirm announce_window, assign comms lead.

Priya S.: Yep. I'll include a checklist template and stage in staging first.

Sofia L.: Next steps/outcomes: 
- Priya to stage CRM rule and checklist (due: today EOD)
- Kunal to update NimbleWorks intake UX to include customer_acknowledged_joint_play + announce_window (due: tomorrow)
- Ethan to coordinate announcement plan for acct_8201 and confirm who leads (due: 48h)

Kunal (NimbleWorks): Noted. We'll also add a training slide for our onboarding about not assuming marketplace toggles equal unilateral ownership.

Priya S.: Staging rule pushed. Will roll to prod once Sofia's short guidance doc is posted.

Sofia L.: I'll draft the one-pager with guardrails + announcement coordination bullets and drop the link here when ready. Closing after prod rollout. :rocket:
